answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. Consider a fable at the center, a delta resting nearby, and a beacon beyond the hills: three anchors, none forged, all earned over time.
